name: University of Delhi
summary: The University of Delhi was founded in 1922 with three colleges — St. Stephen's, Hindu and Ramjas — and now spans 77 colleges, 16 faculties and 86 departments across the city. Undergraduate seats in every college are filled through CUET (UG) scores and DU's Common Seat Allocation System (CSAS).

totalStudents.notes: Regular students (UG 114,494; PG 17,941), excluding about 2.6 lakh in non-formal programmes, as stated on the About page.

applicationPlatform.value: CUET (UG) by NTA, then DU's CSAS (UG) portal for programme and college preferences; seats allotted in rounds by CUET score

testing.notes: Merit is the CUET score in the programme-specific subject combination; Class XII marks only decide eligibility and ties.

domesticTuition.notes: Fees are set by each college and programme

Fill DU's Common Seat Allocation System form and rank programme–college combinations.
DU allots seats by CUET score round by round; accept, upgrade or freeze each allocation.
